name: ref-audit-stream-lag
displayName: REF - Security audit stream lagging on an online workstation
description: Per computer: the machine has sent a heartbeat in the last 15 minutes but its newest Security event in the workspace is more than 60 minutes old (or none in 2 hours). Catches a partial pipeline failure or a suppressed audit stream that the heartbeat-based silence alerts cannot see. Raised 8 Oct 2026 after WS01 heartbeats resumed while its Security events lagged. NIST 3.3.1, 3.3.4.
